found.name: Generative AI at Westminster online courses
found.quote: To access the University's free online courses on Generative AI (including an Introduction to Generative AI, AI and Ethics and the AI and the future Workplace), sign in to your Blackboard and click on ‘Generative AI at Westminster’ on your ‘My Courses’ page in Blackboard.
